name: Data Preview Sterilizer
implementation_notes: Mirrors DataPreviewCpoDispatchView.vue's dual route-driven mode pattern exactly: LIST mode (no :id param, via getAllRecords()) with client-side date+search filter (default date = today), DETAIL mode (:id param present, via getDraftWithDetails()) rendering the header + Log Siklus table read-only

A watch() on the id route param (immediate: true), not a one-time onMounted read, drives both the initial load and every list<->detail transition within the same component instance — Vue Router reuses this instance for param-only navigations on the same route record

Test file's useRoute() mock returns a fresh reactive() object created in beforeEach (not mutated in-place across the whole file) — same convention as DataPreviewCpoDispatchView.spec.ts, avoiding leftover watchers from earlier tests corrupting later mock call counts

Log Siklus table rendered read-only directly from stored columns (no recomputation) — duration_minutes shown exactly as persisted (already server-finalized), consistent with the 'computed then persisted, never recomputed on read' convention used throughout this codebase for derived numeric fields

Detail-mode preview table shows a condensed column set (Sterilizer No, Close Door Time, Open Door Time, Duration (Minutes), Number of Cages, Cages Status, Checked by SPV) rather than all 13 detail columns — Peak/Exhaust Time columns omitted from this condensed mobile view (full column set is only shown on the web Detail/Form screens), mirroring CPO Dispatch Data Preview's own condensed mobile table convention
This is the FINAL station of this project (18th and last of the 18 canonical stations, promoted 2026-09-01)

REVISI (tech-spec v2, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): mode detail memasang RecordVerificationActions (station-type='sterilizer', local-table='sterilizer_record') yang memanggil PATCH /api/records/sterilizer/{server_id}/verification; backend RecordVerificationService::setVerification menerapkan peran + cakupan mill lalu assertPeriodOpenForWrite (EnforcesPeriodLock) atas `date` header record sebelum menulis — periode stasiun tidak terbuka / tanggal di luar rentang → 422 PERIOD_CLOSED tanpa perubahan kolom; komponen menampilkan pesan server dan baris lokal tidak diperbarui (UPDATE lokal hanya setelah sukses); offline → pesan 'Butuh koneksi internet untuk verifikasi'. Tercakup oleh backend/tests/Feature/Api/RecordVerificationTest.php (blok 'kunci periode pada jalur verifikasi') dan backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php; mobile/tests/recordVerification.spec.ts mencakup galat offline tetapi belum punya kasus PERIOD_CLOSED khusus.

REVISI v3 (2026-10-03, sinkronisasi catatan uji — kode tidak diubah): celah 'recordVerification.spec.ts belum punya kasus PERIOD_CLOSED khusus' pada catatan REVISI kunci periode di atas kini TERTUTUP — mobile/tests/recordVerification.spec.ts menambah 'shows the period-lock (422 PERIOD_CLOSED) message verbatim as an error and leaves the local row untouched' untuk komponen bersama RecordVerificationActions yang dipasang di mode detail layar ini: pesan server 422 PERIOD_CLOSED ditampilkan apa adanya sebagai galat dan baris lokal tidak di-UPDATE. Uji hijau.
